sonnet.problem: The question says "the men" and "what happened" without saying who the men are or what happened (the angel's visit and message). The baker can't see the earlier cards, so the question points back to them.
sonnet.rule: **Always give context in the question.** The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
